description: Cluster and de-duplicate texts — Group 3-100 short texts by meaning (support tickets, reviews, survey answers, search queries, headlines). items= separated by | or newlines. Embeds with bge-base-en-v1.5, then average-linkage clustering: threshold= (default 0.75; lower = broader groups) or k= for an exact number of groups. Returns clusters sorted by size with exemplar (most central item), cohesion, keywords and members ranked by similarity, outliers, near-duplicate pairs (dup_threshold= default 0.95) and uniqueIndexes for de-duplication. labels=1 adds a short AI-written name per cluster. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
